# FuseAI MCP

FuseAI MCP lets authorized agents search prospects, manage lists and campaigns, work with email and LinkedIn inboxes, monitor signals, inspect analytics and website intent, manage integrations and settings, and run external or deep research.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/fuseai-mcp/.

## Actions

- **Agents**: The Agents / Signals feature.
- **Analytics** (read-only): Read-only performance dashboards & metrics.
- **Ask fuse brain** (read-only): Ask the Fuse Brain — living relationship files for ENGAGED contacts/companies, built from the team's real emails, LinkedIn messages, calls…
- **Automations**: Create and manage AUTOMATIONS — scheduled or event-triggered multi-step rules (website/news monitors with Slack digests, follow-up drafts,…
- **Campaigns**: Outreach campaigns and their email/LinkedIn/dialer SEQUENCES, end to end.
- **Deep research start**: Starts an asynchronous Fuse Deep Research run.
- **Deep research status** (read-only): Checks a Fuse Deep Research run started with deep_research_start.
- **Inbox**: Use for anything in the user's inbox / messaging.
- **Integrations**: CRM & integrations.
- **Power dialer** (read-only): Power Dialer — call history (READ-ONLY).
- **Prospect lists**: Manage the user's prospect lists.
- **Prospect search**: Find people and companies, generate prospect/company search filters from a natural-language description, enrich contacts, and save…
- **Research**: EXTERNAL / internet research and web tasks.
- **Settings**: Account & workspace settings.
- **Smart actions**: The Smart Actions feed — the home list of suggested next actions per contact, aggregated from website visits, signal-monitor matches,…
- **Website intent** (read-only): Use for Website Intent READ-ONLY reports + tracking config.
